description: A hand-built bulk-actions toolbar for the Svelte 5 data grid. When rows are checked, a sticky bar slides in above the grid with Mark, Delete and Copy as TSV; Clear or unchecking the rows dismisses it. The wiring is onRowSelectionChange to learn which rows are selected, a toolbar that reads that array, and mutations written back to the rows state, with api.clearRowSelection to reset. It is the do-it-yourself version of the built-in selectionBar.

faq.question: How do I know which rows are checked?
faq.answer: Pass onRowSelectionChange. It is called with the selection state and the selected row objects; the demo keeps those rows in $state and shows the toolbar whenever the array is non-empty.

faq.question: How do I delete or update the selected rows?
faq.answer: Mutate your own rows array: filter out the selected ids for Delete, or map over it for Mark. The grid re-renders from the new array, then api.clearRowSelection() empties the checkboxes.

faq.question: When should I use the built-in selectionBar instead?
faq.answer: When you want the bar working out of the box with a count chip, Select all, a bulk-edit drawer and an overflow menu. Stay with this pattern when the toolbar must be your own markup in your own layout.
